data.description: A promethean creature gains a +4 bonus on saving throws vs. poison and disease, is immune to emotion effects except those that produce rage, hatred, or anger. Promethean creatures automatically stabilize when below 0 hp. A promethean creature doesn't need to eat, sleep, or drink.
